declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.global_frontier_coverage
declarations.type: aligned enumeration and frontier certificates imply coverage of every globally admissible route

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.globally_undominated_route_is_retained
declarations.type: every globally undominated admissible route belongs to the certified frontier

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.frontier_route_is_globally_undominated
declarations.type: every route retained by a certified frontier is globally undominated

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.certified_frontier_is_exactly_global_undominated
declarations.type: frontier membership is equivalent to global admissibility and global undominatedness

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.aligned_certificates_use_current_generation
declarations.type: aligned certificates bind both certificate identities to the current graph generation

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.stale_catalog_identity_is_rejected
declarations.type: a certificate bound to a different catalog identity cannot align with the current identity

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.local_frontier_can_miss_global_undominated_route
declarations.type: a locally valid frontier over an incomplete catalog can omit a globally undominated route

declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteCertifiedFrontierCoverage.incomplete_catalog_has_no_global_enumeration_certificate
declarations.type: an incomplete route catalog cannot carry the required global enumeration certificate
